mapping_evidence: prepare_openwebmath_large.py coordinator merges jobs in index order; insert_record appends train tokens at state token offset; manifest shard_sampling follows the same order with each exact quota. Midpoint maps each 2048-token training block to one shard. Source-boundary blocks are approximate and counted.
interpretation: All sampled early and late windows are close to uniform source-shard quotas; deviations are consistent with finite-population random-permutation sampling noise. This gives no evidence of sequential source-shard training or pronounced shard-level temporal distribution drift. Source parquet shard identity is only a coarse proxy and cannot exclude changes in semantic topic, language, document quality, or packing boundary effects.
